parameters.jsCode:
const p = $json;
const config = $('00 - Config').first().json;

const promptTemplate = "You are a senior e-commerce product research analyst.\n\n" +
"Evaluate the following product SPECIFICALLY for this market context:\n" +
"Country: " + config.country + "\n" +
"Niche: " + config.niche + "\n" +
"Primary marketing platforms: TikTok, Snapchat, Instagram\n\n" +
"Product details (this is the ONLY source of truth about the product):\n" +
"- Name: " + p.product_name + "\n" +
"- Brand: " + p.brand + "\n" +
"- Category: " + p.category + "\n" +
"- Description: " + p.description + "\n" +
"- Selling Price: " + p.selling_price + " " + p.currency + "\n" +
"- Supplier Price: " + p.supplier_price + " " + p.currency + "\n" +
"- Gross Profit: " + p.gross_profit + " " + p.currency + "\n" +
"- Margin: " + p.margin_percent + "%\n\n" +
"Important: This is DEMO/placeholder product data (source = " + p.source + "). Do not claim you performed live market research. Base your analysis only on the information given plus general domain knowledge.\n\n" +
"STRICT EVIDENCE RULES — you must follow all of these:\n" +
"1. Never invent social proof.\n" +
"2. Never invent customer numbers, reviews, ratings, popularity, sales volume, or testimonials.\n" +
"3. Never say \"best seller\", \"viral\", \"loved by thousands\", \"popular in Saudi Arabia\", or similar phrases unless verified source data explicitly supports it.\n" +
"4. Never claim a product is specifically formulated for Saudi Arabia or the Saudi climate unless this exists in the source data above.\n" +
"5. Never invent medical, dermatological, therapeutic, or physiological benefits.\n" +
"6. Product benefits must come only from the supplied product description/data above — do not add benefits that are not stated or directly implied there.\n" +
"7. If evidence for a strong claim is missing, use neutral marketing language instead of fabricating evidence (e.g. describe the product itself rather than asserting unverified outcomes or popularity).\n" +
"8. Do not mention the brand \"Lunara\" as the manufacturer of this product unless the product data explicitly states Lunara is the brand. Lunara is the STORE/E-COMMERCE BRAND selling the product, not necessarily its manufacturer.\n" +
"9. Hooks must be compelling but evidence-safe — no fabricated stats, claims, or social proof.\n" +
"10. Do not claim live Saudi market research has occurred unless live research evidence is supplied to you. For this DEMO product data, no live research has been performed.\n" +
"11. Clearly separate in your reasoning: (a) product facts taken directly from the data above, (b) your own AI marketing interpretation/angle, and (c) verified market evidence (if any was supplied — for DEMO data there is none).\n" +
"12. Set \"evidence_level\" based on what was actually supplied: use \"DEMO\" when the product data is demo/placeholder data (source = DEMO), \"PRODUCT_DATA\" when only real product data (no live market research) was supplied, or \"LIVE_RESEARCH\" only if real live market research evidence was explicitly supplied to you. For this product, source = " + p.source + ", so evidence_level must be \"DEMO\".\n" +
"13. Set \"claim_risk\" to LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH based on how much of your response relies on interpretation versus stated facts (LOW = closely tied to given facts, HIGH = more speculative framing, even if evidence-safe).\n" +
"14. Set \"unsupported_claims_detected\" to a list of any specific unsupported claim types you considered making but avoided (e.g. \"social_proof\", \"saudi_climate_formulation\", \"medical_benefit\"), or an empty array if none were relevant.\n\n" +
"Respond with STRICT JSON only, no markdown fences, matching exactly this schema:\n" +
"{\n" +
"  \"target_customer\": \"\",\n" +
"  \"main_problem\": \"\",\n" +
"  \"selling_angle\": \"\",\n" +
"  \"saudi_market_fit_score\": 0,\n" +
"  \"creative_potential_score\": 0,\n" +
"  \"impulse_purchase_score\": 0,\n" +
"  \"competition_risk_score\": 0,\n" +
"  \"trust_risk_score\": 0,\n" +
"  \"recommended_platform\": \"\",\n" +
"  \"reason\": \"\",\n" +
"  \"hooks\": [],\n" +
"  \"claim_risk\": \"LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH\",\n" +
"  \"unsupported_claims_detected\": [],\n" +
"  \"evidence_level\": \"DEMO|PRODUCT_DATA|LIVE_RESEARCH\"\n" +
"}\n\n" +
"All numeric scores must be integers from 0 to 10. For this DEMO product, evidence_level in your JSON response must be exactly \"DEMO\".";

return {
  json: Object.assign({}, p, { ai_prompt: promptTemplate })
};

parameters.content:
## 📥 INPUT
Manual trigger, global config, and demo candidate products (Beauty & Personal Care, Saudi Arabia). Products are split into individual items for processing.

## 📊 METRICS
Calculates gross profit and margin, and sets default 0-10 scores (marked score_source = demo) until real evidence is available.

## 🤖 AI ANALYSIS
Builds a structured prompt, calls OpenRouter (model configurable in 00 - Config), and safely parses the JSON response — including markdown-fence stripping and parse-error fallback.

## 🧮 SCORING
Computes a weighted 0-100 final_score (Saudi fit 25%, margin 20%, creative 20%, impulse 15%, problem/solution 10%, competition risk 5%, trust risk 5%) and sorts products best-to-worst.

## 🏆 OUTPUT
Returns the Top N (default 3) ranked opportunities with recommendation labels, selling angles, and hooks.
